version.promotionalText: Borrow, lend and organize books with your community of readers. Inventaire.io turns your friends into one big living library.
version.description:
Welcome to Inventaire.io — the app that turns your friends into a living library!

With Inventaire.io you can:
• Build your book inventory in seconds
• Explore the libraries of your friends and the groups you belong to
• Borrow, lend and share your favorite reads
• Search for any book in a snap

Our mission: spread reading around you and give books back their power to bring people together.

Inventaire.io is the official mobile client of the free and collaborative inventaire.io project. Join a kind community of passionate readers!
version.whatsNew:
What's new in 1.2:
• The Lists tab shows each list's first covers and how many items it holds
• A list's type is now spelled out: Work, Author, Publisher
• When you have no list yet, the tab explains what a list is for and offers to create your first one
• A long press on a book or a list row opens its menu right away
• A book's note is saved as you type
• "Unknown author" is shown when a book has no author
• First sync: a progress bar shows how far your inventory has got, and friends appear without waiting for their books
• Signing out removes your personal data from the device
• The Profile now says the app is built on inventaire.io and its open data
